# About This English Translation {.unnumbered}

::: {.version-beta}
**English translation in progress · Chapters 1–8 · October 31, 2026.** This is an AI-generated translation of the Spanish edition **1.0**, published on October 31, 2026: [DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23835733](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23835733). The Spanish edition is the original reference text prepared and reviewed by the authors.
:::

**Start with [“Evolution and Optimization”](01-evolucion.qmd), or open the [contents](indice.qmd).** Chapters 1–8 are translated in full, including their examples, exercises, solutions, figures, and further reading. The remaining chapter entries take you to the Spanish original through clearly marked navigation pages.

The book is intended for undergraduate students who are new to genetic algorithms. You can follow the basic path using paper, a calculator, and the interactive tools of the [Genetic Algorithms Lab](https://josemagalan.github.io/genetic-algorithms-lab/#lang=en).

## Levels {.unnumbered}

- **Basic:** the main path, shown in blue. Follow the explanation, predict each example's result, and check it in the application.
- **Advanced:** optional sections that extend the basic path and may require additional knowledge.
- **Further reading:** optional discussions and references for exploring a topic beyond the basic path.

Examples open the tool with fixed data. “In the Application” boxes invite you to explore. Exercises can be worked out on paper; their solutions remain folded until you choose to open them.

## Translation and Review {.unnumbered}

The translation was prepared on October 31, 2026, by **Codex (GPT-6)** (chapters 1–5) and **Claude (Cowork; configured model claude-opus-5-5)** (chapters 6–8). Each translated chapter is compared with the Spanish source for terminology, numbers, formulas, citations, links, and activity settings, then given a separate pass for natural English. The author gave the chapter 5 pilot a favorable general assessment. **A complete human review of the English translation is pending.** Checks and editorial review by an AI assistant do not constitute an independent human review.

See the [translation notice, credits, license, and contact information](avisos.qmd), the [contents](indice.qmd), or the [activity index](actividades.qmd).
